caption: The drawing consists of a tan-brown shaded background that gradually fades at the edges, over which several elements are arranged. At the top center, the text "J. FISHER LYONSNY." is inscribed in a semicircle, and below it is the number "5." written in blue. In the middle of the drawing, there is a symmetrical, abstract design resembling a stylized flower or burst, rendered in blue with intricate curved lines and dot accents. Below the central motif, the text "lyons ny." is written in blue script. In the lower right corner, there is an outlined sketch of a jug or stoneware container, drawn in blue, showing a handle on the neck and a decorative motif matching the central design. The artist's name "GEO. LOUGHRIDGE" appears in small, faint capitals in the lower left corner. Two oval shapes, shaded to suggest depth, are positioned near the top left and top right of the brown shaded area.
title: Jug
